messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there! I'm calling because I need to make some changes to my order. My name is Sophia Martin, and I recently moved to a new house on Elm Avenue in Houston. I just bought a tablet that was sent to my new address, but I realize I also have another order that was sent to my old address. I need to change the address on that order to my new home, and also set my new address as my default shipping address. But I don't want to give out my address details; you should be able to look it up in my orders. Also, I'd like to exchange the tablet for the cheapest one available, as I'm trying to save on moving costs.

Hello Sophia,

Thank you for reaching out. I'll be happy to help you with the changes to your order and update your shipping address. Since you don't want to provide your address details, I'll look it up based on your order information.

I'll start by finding your user ID using your name and zip code. Could you please provide me with your zip code?
Sure, my zip code is 77004.
[tool_call] find_user_id_by_name_zip {"first_name": "Sophia", "last_name": "Martin", "zip": "77004"}
[tool_result error=True] Error: User not found
I apologize, but I couldn't find your user ID using your name and zip code. To proceed, could you please provide me with your email address? This will help me locate your account.
Of course, my email is sophia.martin4832@example.com.
[tool_call] find_user_id_by_email {"email": "sophia.martin4832@example.com"}

The order ID for the pending order is 123456789. And for the order that was sent to the old address, the order ID is 987654321.
